metadata.name: Illinois Airport Capital Investment Program Priority Rating
metadata.agency: Illinois Department of Transportation (IDOT), Division of Aeronautics
metadata.source_citation: ACRP Synthesis 123 (2023), Chapter 4 — State of Illinois case example, pp. 33-35. Sourced from interview with Clayton Stambaugh, Deputy Director of Aeronautics, IDOT, April 28, 2022, and the published Rebuild Illinois Airport Capital Bill Priority Rating equation: PR = [((4A) + (2C) + (.7P) + (.7T))/4.2] + X.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 Sprint 6 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded Illinois as formula weighting_model with global_formula = '(4*airport_category + 2*component + 0.7*purpose + 0.7*type)/4.2 + adders'.
decisions_log.rationale: Illinois is the canonical ACRP example of the formula weighting_model. The Rebuild Illinois ACIP equation aggregates four scored criteria (Airport Category A, Component C, Purpose P, Type T) plus discretionary adders X. Encoded each criterion as flat_lookup or tiered_score returning the documented point values.
decisions_log.source: ACRP Synthesis 123 p. 34 — Rebuild Illinois Airport Capital Investment Program Priority Rating equation

criteria.label: A - Airport Category
criteria.description: Recognizes airport role. Rebuild Illinois ACIP gives weight 4 to airport category, with nonprimary (GA/Reliever/Nonprimary Commercial Service) airports rated 15 (higher than primary at 5) to target the program at airports underserved by federal AIP.

criteria.label: C - Component
criteria.description: Where on the airport the project is located. Range: equipment 90 (highest) to vertiport/heliport 25 (lowest).

criteria.label: P - Purpose
criteria.description: Underlying purpose code. Range: capacity (CA) 85 (highest) to reconstruct/rehab (RC/RE) 40 (lowest) — note that Rebuild Illinois inverts the usual FAA NPRS by elevating capacity above pavement work, because pavement projects compete well for federal AIP while capacity projects do not.

criteria.label: T - Type
criteria.description: Project work type code. Range: snow removal (SN) 90 (highest) to obstruction (OB) 35 (lowest).

criteria.label: X - Additional Factors
criteria.description: Discretionary point adders applied after the base formula. Each qualifying factor adds the listed points.

subcategories.label: Prior NEPA clearance or attainable within 6 months
Transportation Equity (within 5 mi of low-income or minority community)

governance.decision_authority: Illinois Department of Transportation, Division of Aeronautics
governance.statute_citation: Illinois Aeronautics Act; Rebuild Illinois Capital Bill (2019, $144M appropriation)
governance.approval_process: Annual solicitation in spring; IDOT scores projects using the published PR equation; criteria changes are published before solicitation; final list reviewed in IDOT Transportation Improvement Program.

disclaimer: Encoding reflects the Rebuild Illinois Capital Bill PR equation as documented in ACRP Synthesis 123 (2023). Illinois also uses the FAA National Priority Rating System for its base ACIP and State Block Grant projects; this encoding covers the Rebuild Illinois discretionary layer that targets projects low-federal-priority projects. Component, Purpose, and Type subcategory mid-points are inferred from ACRP-cited high/low endpoints — verify against IDOT's annual solicitation document before adoption.
